class.rites_and_paths.spin_master.name: Spin Master
subclass.rites_and_paths.spin_rider.name: Rider
ability.rites_and_paths.sphere_throw.des: With the bandolier in hand: left click, the ball is guided toward where you aim until it bounces (it reaches farther but is a bit slower); right click, it curves toward where you look, and holding it charges the throw: fully charged, it reaches twice as far, stays stuck twice as long and deals ×1.5 damage. The ball drills into the target and spins on it for about 2 seconds, damaging it nonstop (ignoring its invulnerability), bounces off blocks and comes back to your hand. Clicking right as it arrives is a Perfect Catch: more Spin and you throw it again instantly. Every block it bounces off before hitting adds damage.
ability.rites_and_paths.spin_bar.name: Spin
ability.rites_and_paths.spin_bar.desc: A 0-100% bar that fills with every hit, more if you chain them. If a ball comes back without hitting any enemy, you lose half of it; out of combat it slowly drains. At 33%: one more bounce and golden trails. At 66%: a stronger material effect and a bit more damage. At 100%: you can use the Golden Rectangle (from Total Level 30).
ability.rites_and_paths.bounce_route.des: Billiard shot: your ball shoots toward the enemy you aim at and jumps from enemy to enemy, hitting each one in passing (every hit strikes harder than the last), until it drills into the last one. With a single enemy, it bounces around it and comes back for it. Every hit raises your Spin.
ability.rites_and_paths.reverse_spin.des: Pulls on your embedded ball (or on the last enemy you hit a moment ago) and drags it towards you. Bosses do not move. Detonates your mines.
ability.rites_and_paths.spin_step.name: Spin Step
ability.rites_and_paths.spin_step.desc: A spiral dash of about 6 blocks towards where you move (or where you look if you stand still). Your next hit shortly after gives more Spin.
ability.rites_and_paths.golden_rectangle: With Spin at 100%, an automatic sequence with a cinematic camera: time stops around you, you scan the enemy you aim at and throw a golden ball that holds it in an infinite rotation, damaging it nonstop; even if it tries to escape, the rotation drags it back. A last critical blow slams it into the ground and the rotation jumps to nearby enemies. While it lasts you cannot move, but you take no damage.
ability.rites_and_paths.shared_weak_poin: Your allies also see the Weak Point marks, and every hit renews them.
class.rites_and_paths.spin_master.desc: Throws balls of different materials that drill in spinning, bounce and come back to the hand: left click, guided toward where you aim; right click, curved and chargeable; the bandolier holds the balls and a key switches the one you use. Hybrid skirmisher: hits up close and from afar and rewards rhythm, combos and precision. Every chained hit raises their Spin, which empowers the balls and charges the Golden Rectangle.
branch.rites_and_paths.spin_master.rotat: Your balls deal more damage and your Spin rises faster.
branch.rites_and_paths.spin_master.rebou: More bounces, and balls that bounce from one enemy to another keep more damage.
branch.rites_and_paths.spin_master.spher: Your balls are ready sooner after coming back and, with the full branch, you can have one more in flight.
More critical chance and damage; your critical hits with balls ignore part of the armor.
branch.rites_and_paths.spin_master.curve: The curved throw (right click) curves more and your balls fly farther.
perk.rites_and_paths.spin_master.rotatio: Your balls deal more damage while they spin stuck in the target, but Spin rises a bit slower.
Spin rises much faster, but your balls deal a bit less damage.
perk.rites_and_paths.spin_master.rebound: One more bounce, but every chained bounce deals less damage than the one before.
Your balls no longer bounce off blocks, but they jump to two more enemies.
perk.rites_and_paths.spin_master.sphere_: One more ball in flight at once, but they take longer to be ready after coming back.
If they hit, your balls return to your hand instantly, but you have one ball fewer in flight (at least one).
perk.rites_and_paths.spin_master.scan.co: The first hit on each target is a guaranteed critical (once in a while per target), but your general critical chance drops.
perk.rites_and_paths.spin_master.scan.st: Every consecutive hit on the same target deals more damage; it resets when you switch targets.
perk.rites_and_paths.spin_master.curve.t: The curved throw curves twice as much, but your balls fly less far.
perk.rites_and_paths.spin_master.curve.g: While a ball is flying, a right click instantly redirects it once towards where you look (instead of charging another one). Your balls are a bit slower.
class.rites_and_paths.spin_master.trait: Class trait: a bit less maximum health.
subclass.rites_and_paths.spin_rider.desc: Spins at full speed: if your balls hit while you run (or ride) close to your top speed, they stun the target and deal a bit more damage.
subclass.rites_and_paths.spin_scanner.de: Reads weak points: the first ball that hits a target marks it, and the following ones are guaranteed criticals. From level 5, your allies see the mark and every hit renews it.
subclass.rites_and_paths.spin_trapper.de: Plants their balls as mines: while sneaking, the ball sticks into the ground or a wall and explodes when an enemy walks by, slowing it down.
